documentation: This file defines the structure of the immutable 'experiment_meta' artifact that should be archived for each experiment run to ensure reproducibility. It links the pre-registration to the specific stimuli, code, and data versions.

experimentId.description: A unique identifier for this specific experiment run (e.g., 'exp_003_pilot_1').

codeSha.description: The full Git commit SHA of the application code used for this experiment run. This provides an immutable link to the exact version of the application logic.

stimuliVersion.description: The version identifier for the stimuli used in this experiment (e.g., 'v1.0'). This corresponds to the content in 'advisory_memos.json' and 'dossier_texts.json'.

lexiconVersion.description: The version identifier for the linguistic lexicon used for LA_OBJECTIVE computation. This corresponds to the content in 'lcm_lexicon.json'.

randomizationLogicVersion.description: Version of the randomization logic as described in 'randomization_logic.md'.

exportLogic.description: A summary of the logic used to generate the final, processed data export (`handleExport` function in `src/app/admin/analysis/page.tsx`).

description.example: Calculates composites with >=75% completeness rule, maps choices to codes, redacts free text, and binarizes flags.
